title: Social Memory cuing
description: EEG dataset recorded while participants performed a visual working memory task in virtual reality using a head-mounted display. Memory items (a bowl, cup, plate and teapot) were cued by either a virtual avatar or a stick, with cues that were spatially valid or invalid. Participants were probed on item location and item status. The dataset includes raw and processed EEG, behavioral data, event codes and analysis code.
methods_description: Participants wore a head-mounted display and completed a virtual reality visual working memory task. An avatar or a stick cued left or right, and objects appeared on the left or right, so cues were either valid or invalid. Participants were probed on memory for item location and then item status while EEG was recorded.
